Class Mark

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.Mark
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Mark extends Object implements Serializable
Course mark made of three components — 1st attestation (0..30), 2nd attestation (0..30), final exam (0..40). Total 0..100.
